goal: Wave 1 build: Shared queued input and cross-replica liveness; Egress declaration, evidence, runbook; Client fail-closed gate where media is really lost; Anthropic tiered system blocks

slices.title: Shared queued input and cross-replica liveness
slices.summary: Queue and probe ops go over the run-control bus so queued input and resume liveness work from any replica: the ZDR and waived gate runs before any queue text leaves the replica, enqueue becomes checked (thread mismatch 409, duplicate op_id returns the same item, bounded seen-ops), and the resume tail uses a cached cross-replica probe in place of the local-only producer check. Persist still follows enqueue in this slice; the reorder is S6 (D3).
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/rust' && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --test run_control_two_replica_test
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS (same switch as S1; queue and probe ops ride it)

decisions_defaults.DEC-07: (a) NATS request/reply to owner, no message content stored; local hit wins, bus error = 503 `run_control_unavailable` (retryable), never fake 202/404; `/readyz` reports `run_control`. Keep code order (enqueue first) through S3, record ledger correction; reorde

slices.title: Egress declaration, evidence, runbook
slices.summary: Documentation only: adds the customer-configured SIEM destination to the egress scan vendors list and the subprocessor list, extends the ZDR NATS and audit-envelope row, adds the honest limits (a DB-owner attacker is detected only with signature plus external witness; completeness not proven; legacy rows unchained), updates trust-claim section 6, adds AUDIT_CHAIN_RUNBOOK.md and updates the Model Plane status and roadmap. Claims broaden only to what a fresh read shows; edited last.
slices.notes: Do NOT edit these shared files (the lead applies your exact lines after the batch; put them in lead_todo as 'shared-edit <file>: <exact lines>'): apps/Model Plane/MODEL_PLANE_STATUS.md, apps/Model Plane/docs/ZDR.md, docs/compliance/evidence/honest-limits.md, docs/compliance/evidence/subprocessors-from-code.md, docs/compliance/evidence/tools/scan-egress.mjs, docs/compliance/evidence/trust-claims-pending-reverification.md

slices.title: Client fail-closed gate where media is really lost
slices.summary: Adds a pure client attachment policy that refuses each attachment the send path cannot deliver (unsupported type, too large, subscription route, Do images, too many images, ZDR) with a localized per-file reason before anything is sent, and replaces the silent drop on the subscription route with a thrown typed local error attachments_not_sent. No wire change.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/lib/attachment-policy.test.ts src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/features/chat/lib/prepare-chat-attachments.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

slices.title: Anthropic tiered system blocks
slices.summary: Adds InferRequest.prompt_tiers = 18 (PromptTierPlan with stable and context message counts) and maps it in inference-core. The Anthropic provider sends ordered system blocks and marks cache_control on the Stable and Context tiers (at most four breakpoints; the ZDR gate stays the first statement and sends no cache_control); the gateway tool loop and the execution-core agent pass the plan. Gated by INFERENCE_ANTHROPIC_TIERED_SYSTEM.
test_commands: [cwd: apps/Model Plane/rust] cargo test -p inference-core --lib anthropic (new tiered_system_marks_stable_and_context_not_volatile, tiered_system_never_exceeds_four_breakpoints, no_tiers_is_byte_identical_to_today, below_minimum_prefix_marks_nothing, zdr_tiered_request_sends_no_cache_control_and_one_system_string; existing zdr_request_must_not_send_cache_control_anywhere_in_the_body and breakpoint_count_never_exceeds_anthropics_limit_of_four unchanged)
